goal: Decide whether to build, buy, or use open-source for authentication in a new SaaS product

constraints.description: Must support SOC 2 audit requirements or be easily auditable
Must support MFA (TOTP and SMS at minimum)

options.label: Build In-House
options.description: Implement auth from scratch using JWTs, bcrypt, and session management

options.label: Auth0 / Okta
options.description: Managed identity platform with broad protocol support

options.label: Supabase Auth
options.description: Open-source auth built on GoTrue, integrated with Supabase stack

criteria.label: Time to Market
criteria.description: Engineering weeks to reach production-ready auth

criteria.label: Control & Customisability
criteria.description: Ability to customise flows, tokens, and storage

criteria.label: Security Baseline
criteria.description: Out-of-the-box security posture without extra effort
